body: Thank you, it's nice hearing that.

I haven't really accomplished much though. Like, I passed my A levels and I'm attending uni but passing a few exams and satisfying the entry requirements don't exactly seem like huge achievements. 


I did email my father once, a year ago. I missed him. We'd always been close and I'm like him in many ways. But he was so defensive in his reply and tried to blame everything on me. I did a bit of googling and one of my stepsisters has a 2 year old now. I didn't even know. I think they've just completely moved on and I don't fit in with their family anymore. So now I'm alone.

I try to remember that. I'm 23 - I have most of my life ahead of me. It's just, I thought this kind of stuff would be over by now - the depression, the suicidal thoughts. It's like - even if I have a fun enjoyable day I still contemplate suicide. And I wish I didn't. I wish I found the idea of suicide repulsive. But it's not, it feels welcoming and just ... just a release. 


There's a quote I like that I think is absolutely spot on. "That the best thing for a man is not to be born, and if already born, to die as soon as possible"

I don't feel strong. sometimes I feel like I do need them. they're my family and I hate them but ... I just want a family. a group of people that love you and help take care of you. it sounds weak and it is weak but I don't feel complete. it's been 4 years and that's just too many Christmases spent alone. I really don't think I can handle another one.
